integrity: The standalone Python 3 program enumerates all faces, checks membership by two independent methods, verifies matched Hasse acyclicity and critical cell counts; the proof depends on no unprovided dataset.
scientific_limitations: Only n=4,5,6,7,8; no claim for larger ladder graphs. Full finite acyclicity check and standard discrete-Morse theorem give integral homotopy. Unindexed precedence remains possible.
title: Five integral homotopy types of Möbius-ladder two-independence complexes
